how_made: Short answer keys for the generation pages, written on 2026-11-26 by the same AI assistant from each question's evidence span, before any model answered the questions. An answer counts as matching when, after lower-casing and dropping everything but letters and digits, it contains one of the key strings treated the same way. Questions whose answer is a yes/no or a sentence with no distinctive string have no key and are left out of the generation measurements. This is a crude check: it misses right answers worded differently and passes wrong answers that mention the key; the pages that use it say so.
